Made minor adjustments to packages/shared/package.json build scripts (adding then removing a build:dev script). Added a note in CONTRIBUTING.md about retrying pnpm run dx.

change_trajectory: Initial commit: changed turbo.json dev tasks to use @langfuse/shared#dev instead of #build.
Second commit: added incremental build script (build:dev) and updated turbo.json dependencies.
Third commit: removed the build:dev script and reverted turbo.json dependencies.
Final commit: adjusted CONTRIBUTING.md with a note about retrying pnpm run dx.
